250300.title: Sulfur of all kinds (excl. sublimed/precipitated)
250300.boundary: A by-product of oil/gas/smelting moved regionally; most is used on-site and never enters trade.

280700.title: Sulfuric acid; oleum
280700.boundary: The workhorse acid; largely made and consumed at fertilizer and metal plants, so trade is a thin surplus.
